title: Observation Review, Revision Lineage And Series Admission Control Registry
scope: Thirty-two empty observation-review dockets, thirty-two empty revision-lineage registers, and eight not-ready series-admission dockets for the Phase 69 measurement layer.
interpretation_boundary: A review docket is not a submitted observation. A contract-present identity check is not an accepted value. A complete first review is not dual control. A reviewed observation is not automatically a series point, an admitted cohort, a comparison, a causal claim, or an outcome.

review_dimensions.label: Specification and cohort identity
review_dimensions.question: The packet resolves to one exact Phase 69 specification and Phase 68 cohort.

review_dimensions.label: Entity and operating scope
review_dimensions.question: The named entity, facility, project, service, geography, population, and stage remain exact.

review_dimensions.label: Source and issuing authority
review_dimensions.question: The public source and responsible issuing or acceptance authority are explicit.

review_dimensions.label: Artifact integrity and provenance
review_dimensions.question: A stable public locator, capture, version, and provenance trail resolve to the reviewed artifact.

review_dimensions.label: Observed date and period
review_dimensions.question: Observed date, period start, period end, cadence, partial periods, and missing periods are explicit.

review_dimensions.label: Numerator and numerator unit
review_dimensions.question: The source-declared numerator and unit match the specification without inference or silent conversion.

review_dimensions.label: Denominator and denominator unit
review_dimensions.question: The denominator or explicit not-applicable basis and unit are complete and compatible.

review_dimensions.label: Method and version
review_dimensions.question: The collection, calculation, test, threshold, and method version are inspectable.

review_dimensions.label: Acceptance and recurrence basis
review_dimensions.question: The receiving or acceptance authority and same-entity recurring-operation basis are explicit.

review_dimensions.label: Exceptions and adverse observations
review_dimensions.question: Failures, outages, rejections, exclusions, and adverse observations remain visible.

review_dimensions.label: Revision, correction, and break review
review_dimensions.question: Corrections, supersessions, withdrawals, restatements, and prospective series breaks are adjudicated.

review_dimensions.label: Receipt and propagation boundary
review_dimensions.question: A bounded receipt type and complete reader-surface propagation assignment follow the human decision.

admission_dimensions.label: Exact cohort identity
admission_dimensions.question: The admission docket preserves the same file, entity, scope, and measurement contracts.

admission_dimensions.label: Independently reviewed observation set
admission_dimensions.question: Every proposed series point has a completed dual-control observation decision.

admission_dimensions.label: Accepted recurring operation
admission_dimensions.question: The exact entity has accepted repeated service, output, use, shipment, monitoring, or operation.

admission_dimensions.label: Compatible measure and unit
admission_dimensions.question: Numerators and source-declared units are stable or publicly reconciled.

admission_dimensions.label: Compatible denominator or exposure
admission_dimensions.question: Denominators, populations, capacity, exposure, or explicit not-applicable bases are stable or reconciled.

admission_dimensions.label: Compatible period, method, and revision history
admission_dimensions.question: Cadence, missing periods, method versions, corrections, and restatements remain inspectable.

admission_dimensions.label: All series breaks adjudicated
admission_dimensions.question: Every identity, scope, unit, denominator, period, method, authority, revision, exception, or attribution break is visible.

admission_dimensions.label: Human admission and complete propagation
admission_dimensions.question: Two authorized reviewers issue the bounded admission decision and complete all assigned propagation.
